annotations.title: Can I still ship for Christmas

description: For a ship date (default today, US Eastern) and a destination, lists each USPS service with its send-by date, days left and whether it is still on time for December 25, and names the slowest (usually cheapest) service still on time. Destination can be "lower48", a state or territory ("Alaska", "Hawaii", "Puerto Rico", "Guam"), a country ("Canada", "Germany", "Japan"), a USPS region ("Europe") or an APO/FPO/DPO ZIP ("APO 09021").

ship_date.description: Date you will drop it off, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today in US Eastern time.

name: check_holiday_ship_by_date
title: Check if a package still makes Christmas
